title: Instagram image-to-image prompts stop getting mangled
summary:
A small maintenance day: cleaner Instagram I2I inputs, better cost visibility, and fresher model-status communications.

Instagram I2I generation no longer double-encodes URLs, so image inputs arrive at the generator in the form they were meant to.

A new Tier Costs dashboard makes cost analysis easier, alongside refreshed deployment instructions and a seven-day default for the economics workflow.

The model announcement was added to the project news channels, keeping people pointed at the current set of available options rather than old assumptions.
